top_stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a lower-cost model said to outscore Argon
top_stories.description: Google LLC today released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a lower-cost model in its Gemini 4 artificial intelligence family that it says outscores its frontier Gemini 4 Argon model on an independent intelligence ranking. Measured on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level, Hydrogen scored 51 to Argon’s 50, according to Google. top_stories.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
